mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_report (user_id, report_date, today_finish, encounter_problem, tomorrow_plan, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{reportDate}, #{todayFinish}, #{encounterProblem}, #{tomorrowPlan}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE daily_report SET report_date = #{reportDate}, today_finish = #{todayFinish}, encounter_problem = #{encounterProblem}, tomorrow_plan = #{tomorrowPlan}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM daily_report WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (today_finish LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR encounter_problem LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR tomorrow_plan LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY report_date DESC
